mechanism: St. John's wort induces CYP3A4 and may enhance glucuronidation, reducing atovaquone plasma concentrations and therapeutic efficacy in treating Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia or toxoplasmosis.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if St. John's wort cannot be discontinued, monitor atovaquone efficacy closely and consider alternative antiretroviral or antimicrobial therapy with less interaction potential.
